free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0: 250 requests a day (daily cap only), 20 results a request, 30 days of search history, at most 7 days per search; a 300-character text preview per article.
free_tier.notes: Quotas reset at 00:00 UTC; at the daily cap the API answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After, and there is no overage billing. The next plan up is Builder at USD 69 a month for 2,500 requests a day.

per_object_cap.stated: 20 results a request on the Free plan; article text is a 300-character preview
per_object_cap.notes: Paging stops where (page_number - 1) * page_size passes 5000 rows; a larger offset answers HTTP 400.

retention.stated: search reaches 30 days back, at most 7 days per search, on the Free plan

interface_detail: REST over HTTPS at api.currentsapi.services/v1 (latest-news and search); the key goes in the Authorization header (Bearer or the bare key) or the legacy apiKey parameter
chaining: Article metadata, 300-character previews and source links; the full article is fetched from the source URL by a crawler.

binding_note: 250 requests a day is met first; a burst limit of unpublished size also answers 429.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up takes a username, an email and a password, or Microsoft, Google or GitHub sign-in; no card. Temporary or disposable email domains are refused where a permanent address is asked for.

reliability_note: At the daily cap or the burst limit the API answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 Authentication required.
confidence_note: Quota, result cap, history window and sign-up fields are read from first-party pages; a keyless call answered HTTP 401, so the free key was not exercised.
